_comment: RETAIN-KIND-1. What a run's manifest (run.json) says the run IS. The pages (help.js runKind) and the engine (Get-VmfRunKind) answer by this one list. OLD-VERSION-READERS-REMOVE-6: the manifest writer (Initialize-VmfRun) writes kind on every manifest and the contract requires it, so a manifest with no kind is not known: null, never a guess - it is not read as a migration any more. No manifest at all is null too. A kind the schema does not know is returned as written, so it is neither a migration nor an assessment.

cases.why: no manifest, or one that could not be read: not known
no kind: not known, and not a migration - this version writes kind on every manifest
a kind written as null says nothing either
a kind the schema does not know is not made into a migration
